description: Search across Hugging Face models, datasets, and Spaces by keyword (matches the search box on /models, /datasets, /spaces; not README full-text). type filters to all (default, 全部) | model (模型) | dataset (数据集) | space (Space); limit (1-100, default 20) caps results per type. Returns merged items with type, id, url, likes, downloads, tags (pipeline_tag for models, sdk for Spaces). Reads HF list APIs in the browser; no login required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keyword, e.g. vision transformer. Non-empty required.（搜索关键词，如 vision transformer，必填。）

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type: all (default, 全部) | model (模型) | dataset (数据集) | space (Space). all merges the three list APIs; a single type queries only that API.（结果类型。）

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results per type (1-100, default 20).（每种类型返回条数上限。）
